verdict.rationale: Baseten's first-party docs say cached input tokens are served from the KV cache at a discounted rate. Caching is automatic with no request flags, and session-ID routing sends requests to the same replica so shared prefixes are more likely to stay cached. This covers both the cost and the reuse angle of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of latency reduction (not just cost), documentation of caching for dedicated deployments beyond Model APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
